lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in parallel horizontal rows posterior to the branchial slits along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like pattern of local maxima.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features running across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and low-intensity shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs across its lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large elongated organism attached to the dorsal-lateral region posterior to the head, creating a localized silhouette irregularity.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense patterning of high-luminance spots on the superior surface of the visible left pectoral fin.
